title_eng: Music notation software based on the smart device and stylus pen
title_kor: Music notation software based on the smart device and stylus pen
abstract:
This paper describes how capacitive type smart pen 
(smartphone stylus pen) is used to improve the 
composing of handwriting contents and 
summarizing them in the digital note. By using the 
capacitive type stylus pen, we can compose an 
important part of the digital music note contents 
and summarize them quickly and easily. For 
composing of handwriting contents, we define 
variety pen drawing actions in the direct ion of 
horizontality, verticality, subtraction and 
combination. This paper describes a variety of 
usage scenarios based on the actions with the rules 
as mentioned above.

Abstract 
This paper describes how capacitive type smart pen 
(smartphone stylus pen) is used to improve the 
composing of handwriting contents and 
summarizing them in the digital note. By using the 
capacitive type stylus pen, we can compose an 
important part of the digital music note contents 
and summarize them quickly and easily. For 
composing of handwriting contents, we define 
variety pen drawing actions in the direct ion of 
horizontality, verticality, subtraction and 
combination. This paper describes a variety of 
usage scenarios based on the actions with the rules 
as mentioned above. 
Keyword 
Composing Method, Digital Note, Digital Pen 
1. Introduction 
The input method of traditional digital portable 
device had been depended on the keypad . However, 
recently the touch -screen input method has been 
widely used. Nowadays, the users can use various 
touch input such as tap, flick, drag and multi -
touch on the screen of the device. Touch screen 
devices such as tablet have been also used for 
learning at school. Thus, the technology to display 
various contents and editing them on the screen is 
highly required. Since the digital contents of the e -
book format instead of a traditional tex t-book 
have been ut ilized to study at school, the smart 
stylus pen will be very helpful tool to handwrite on 
the digital contents [1]. This means that people can 
use stylus pen or their finger in general compose 
application. Indeed, dynamic editing could b e 
possible based on actions with the rules. We can 
change the styling properties such as compose type 
and a music sheet actions. For example, if people 
want to emphasize certain part of handwriting 
contents, they do horizontal or vertical action on 
the compose application. In this paper, we propose 
the composing methods of handwriting contents 
application by using capacitive type smartphone 
pen drawing. 
2. Smart pen-based music composition 
2.1. Main screen 
Figure 1 shows main s creen configuration of this 
application. In main screed, music score is 
presented in the center and editing tools and menus 
are locating on the right - and top -side, 
respectively. 
 
Figure 1 Main Screen 
3. Notes and rests input 
3.1. Gesture-based input 
In gesture input mode, we defined two pen drawing 
directions - horizontal direction and vertical - for 
composing of handwriting contents quickly and 
easily. Horizontal action can be used a s styling for 
certain line and vertical a ction can be used as 
totally styli ng for certain region. Each action can 
have certain width and height according to 
composing parts. Moreover, we defined reverse 
direction for each direction. Reverse actions are the 
concept of cancellation and restoration of certain

 Putting note and rest 
In composition mode, notes or rests could be 
created by pen gesture. Note or rest which could 
not be drawn at a time could be input by adding 
on pre-input note/rest. Our application supports a 
whole note, half note, quarter note, eighth note, 
sixteenth note and thirty-second note. Moreover, it 
also supports dotted and double dotted note for all 
kinds of notes. In the same way, our applica tion 
supports rest corresponding to the note. Figure 2 
and Figure 3 show gesture for putting that note 
and rest, respectively. 
 
 
 
 
 
Figure 2 Gesture for putting note 
 
 
 
 
Figure 3 Gesture for putting rest 
 Overlay 
Additional gesturin g using the p en on the entered 
note / comma allows add ing or modifying points, 
tails, columns, heads, etc., and change them to 
another note / comma. If it is a supported note or 
comma, it can be input by over lay. Figure 4 and 
Figure 5 show the overlay gest ure for notes and 
rests, respectively 
 Edit pitch 
Pitch could be edited by long press. If user press the 
note long -time, the selected note turns blue and 
can be changed to the desired note. (See Figure 6)

 Sharp / Flat / Natural 
The sharp, flat, and a natural applied to the notes 
are only va lid for that node. For general notes , 
sharp, flat or natural input mode, the 
corresponding effect ( Sharp, Flat, and A Natural) 
of the selected note is applied by touching the note. 
If user touch a note that has already been set, 
double-sharp or double -flat will be applied . For 
chord notes, the effect applies only to the selected 
note if user touch the pen to a particular note of a 
note in a sharp, flat or natural mode . If user touch 
a note that has already been set, double -sharp or 
double-flat will be applied. 
 Adding a chord 
When you are in the drawing mode, you can add 
the corresponding chord by touching the desired 
note position of the note to be added with S-Pen. 
 Modify the rhythm and remove notes and 
commas 
In erase mode, if you touch S -Pen to delete not es 
and comma (specific note in chord note), you can 
edit only the corresponding part (additive effect or 
point, tail, column, etc.) do. Draw a straight line to 
delete single or multiple notes. 
 Edit / Delete notes and commas 
The entered notes and commas can be edited and 
deleted. The edit function applies to one note / 
comma, but the delete function can be applied to 
multiple notes / comma as well as single.
